subject: Re: Thursday appointment
text: Hi there, I just wanted to follow up because I know we talked earlier about the appointment you were trying to keep for Thursday afternoon, and I've been thinking about it all morning. I checked again, and apparently the original place got a sudden cancellation and moved the whole afternoon block, which is annoying, but they said if you can be flexible they might squeeze you in tomorrow morning between the clinic's first wave of visits and the later paperwork rush. That may still be too early for you, especially if you're coordinating that ride with your sister, so here's another option: if the first slot doesn't work, they mentioned they can hold the 3:15 instead, and I could drop by afterward if you want company for the walk to the car. Honestly, I'd feel less worried if we pick one and text it in so there isn't another scramble. I'm not trying to push anything, just trying to make the day feel less like a puzzle before it starts. Sorry for all the back and forth, but I know how much you like having a backup plan without feeling rushed, so I wanted to cover a few possibilities before you have to think about it during work. I know the last time I called about something like this I ended up sounding too eager, but I've already made a little calendar note, put on a comfortable coat, and planned to stop near the side entrance if it helps. Whatever time you choose, I can be there with snacks, a water, and enough patience to stand around while the front desk does its usual slow check-in. The main thing is not to lose your place again.
